description: Starts rating with Libertas's panel of A-rated carriers and returns right away. First prices usually arrive within 30-90 seconds as honest ranges (the low end is the carrier's own preliminary figure). Libertas then keeps working for 2-10 minutes to capture exact, bindable rates directly from carrier systems, so options move from 'estimate' to 'verified'. Follow progress with check_quote_status every turn or two. Calling this again with unchanged details returns the run already in progress; changed details start a fresh run.

max_options.description: Maximum options to return per line (1-5, default 3).

quote_id.description: The quote session id returned by start_quote.

name: get_quote_options

outputSchema.description: Acknowledges the rate run started; poll check_quote_status for the option cards.

title: Get quote options
